events.title: Demo Update: Smaller Build, Improved Scaling, and Critical Bug Fix
events.summary: This update includes the following improvements:- Reduced texture sizes which lowered the demo build size from 3.6GB to 1.6GB - Fixed a scaling issue affecting cutscenes on various screen sizes - Resolved a critical bug that could lock the player and halt progress Reinstall or update the demo to get the latest patch.
